notebooks.title: 条件数、输入变化与分解求解
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
import mpmath as mp
from scipy.linalg import lu_factor, lu_solve, cho_factor, cho_solve
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
eps=sp.Rational(1,10**6);A=sp.Matrix([[1,1],[1,1+eps]]);b=sp.Matrix([2,2+eps]);bp=b+sp.Matrix([0,eps])
x=A.inv()*b;xp=A.inv()*bp
cond=(2+eps)*(2/eps+1)
print('精确原解/新解/条件数:',x,xp,cond,float(cond))
print('对新输入残差/对旧输入残差/前向变化:',bp-A*xp,b-A*xp,max(abs(v) for v in xp-x))
Af=np.array(A,dtype=float);bf=np.array(b,dtype=float).reshape(-1)
lu=lu_solve(lu_factor(Af),bf);ch=cho_solve(cho_factor(Af),bf)
print('浮点LU/Cholesky解与残差:',lu,ch,np.linalg.norm(Af@lu-bf,np.inf),np.linalg.norm(Af@ch-bf,np.inf))
C=np.array([[1.,0.],[1.,1.],[1.,2.]]);y=np.array([1.,2.,2.]);Q,R=np.linalg.qr(C,mode='reduced');fit=np.linalg.solve(R,Q.T@y);svd=np.linalg.lstsq(C,y,rcond=None)[0]
print('QR/SVD拟合/残差范数/正交残差:',fit,svd,np.linalg.norm(C@fit-y),C.T@(C@fit-y))
print('C与正规方程二范数条件数:',np.linalg.cond(C),np.linalg.cond(C.T@C))

notebooks.setupCode:

import sympy as sp
import mpmath as mp
from scipy.linalg import lu_factor, lu_solve, cho_factor, cho_solve
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
f=lambda t:20+60*np.exp(-t)-40
lo,hi=0.,4.;count=0
assert f(lo)*f(hi)<0
while hi-lo>1e-6 and count<100:
    mid=(lo+hi)/2
    if f(mid)>0:lo=mid
    else:hi=mid
    count+=1
root=(lo+hi)/2
print('端点/次数/根/区间宽/位置界/实际误差:',f(0),f(4),count,root,hi-lo,(hi-lo)/2,abs(root-np.log(3)))
print('解析根:',np.log(3),'k0有限窗包根:',(80-40)*(80-40)<0)
z=0.;derivative=2*z
print('Newton从0:', '导数为零，拒绝继续' if derivative==0 else '可继续')

notebooks.title: 自适应、事件与刚性双模态
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
import mpmath as mp
from scipy.linalg import lu_factor, lu_solve, cho_factor, cho_solve
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp

cells.code:
def event(t,y):return y[0]-40
event.direction=-1
sol=solve_ivp(lambda t,y:-(y-20),(0,4),[80.],method='RK45',rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10,events=event,dense_output=True)
assert sol.success
hit=sol.t_events[0][0]
print('RK45终点/实际终点误差/事件/事件误差/nfev:',sol.y[0,-1],abs(sol.y[0,-1]-(20+60*np.exp(-4))),hit,abs(hit-np.log(3)),sol.nfev)
print('事件插值温度:',sol.sol(hit)[0],'内部节点数:',len(sol.t))
A=np.diag([-1.,-100.]);stiff=solve_ivp(lambda t,y:A@y,(0,1),[1.,1.],method='Radau',rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-10)
assert stiff.success
print('Radau双模态终点/解析/绝对误差/nfev:',stiff.y[:,-1],np.exp([-1.,-100.]),abs(stiff.y[:,-1]-np.exp([-1.,-100.])),stiff.nfev)
z=sp.Integer(-10);RE=1+z;RB=1/(1-z);R4=1+z+z*z/2+z**3/6+z**4/24
print('快模态E/BE/RK因子与两步:',RE,RB,R4,RE**2,RB**2,R4**2,'解析两步:',np.exp(-20))
